# Namedrop

> Namedrop is a free, browser-based party guessing game for groups sharing one phone or laptop. Teams guess famous names, characters, places and things from one shared deck across three rounds that get harder: describe it, one word, then act it out. No account or download.

- Play: https://ananyajamdagneya.github.io/namedrop/
- Price: free, no sign-up
- Languages: English, Hindi (Devanagari with English spellings)
- Players: 2 to 4 teams (4+ people); draft mode supports 3 to 16 players

## Cards

2,061 cards in total, each worth 1 to 4 points (harder = more):

- Pop Icons (178), Fictional Folks (228), History Makers (139), Sports Legends (87), Internet & Memes (97), Things, Places & Ideas (420), Food & Drink (101), Creature Feature (80)
- हिंदी Deck (229): Bollywood, music, history, mythology and Indian pop culture, in Devanagari with English spellings
- Deep Cuts (502): lesser-known names mixed into every deck; about 5% on Chill, 15% on Mixed, 30% on Hard and 70% on Extra Hard
- Custom cards: players can add their own names, clues and points
- Least-played cards are dealt first, so repeat groups see fresh cards

## How to play

1. Split into teams and sit so teammates alternate.
2. Optional: turn on "Draft the deck" so each player secretly picks their own cards.
3. On a turn (30 to 90 seconds), one player gives clues to their team. Tap Got it or Skip; skipped cards go back in the pile.
4. Round 1, say anything except the name. Round 2, exactly one word per card. Round 3, act it out with no words. Optional bonus round: sound only, guessers' eyes closed.
5. The same deck returns every round. Clear the deck mid-turn and your leftover seconds carry over and your team goes first.
6. Highest total points after the last round wins. A post-game breakdown shows per-card points, team and round stats.
